rationale: The assistant correctly identified a likely blown lamp, specified a 300°C SES/E14 oven bulb, insisted on isolating and cooling first, and flagged lamp holder/wiring as the fallback if the new bulb fails ('if the new one doesn't work, the issue could be with the lamp holder or wiring'). It stayed faithful to the customer's evidence and confirmed E14 once the customer read the old bulb. Weaknesses: it did not proactively tell the customer to read the old bulb rating or how to remove the lens cover when asked 'anything else I should check before I take the glass cover off', repeated the holder/wiring caveat without adding value, omitted matching the 25W rating and refitting the cover before use, and never explicitly said 'engineer' for the fallback.
